billboard on Instagram: "Justin Bieber headlined Coachella 2026 on Saturday night (April 11) with a nostalgia-heavy set that doubled as a full internet time capsule, pulling fans back into his early YouTube era.⁠
⁠
The 32-year-old pop star mixed stadium-sized hits with viral throwbacks, projecting clips like “Double Rainbow” and “Deez Nuts” while revisiting early-career favorites including “Baby” and “Never Say Never.” He even went all the way back to his breakout “With You” cover, turning the set into a journey through his rise to fame.⁠
⁠
The moment quickly became a talking point across the festival. Katy Perry joked about Bieber’s YouTube segment in a viral clip, while Zara Larsson shared her own livestream reaction, calling the vibe “dream blunt rotation” energy.⁠
⁠
Bieber is set to return for weekend two on April 18, with anticipation already building for what he’ll do next.⁠
⁠
More details on the reactions to Bieber's set are at the link in bio."
